newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar ranged on low demand, limited supply.
newsitem.headline: India sugar ranged on low demand, limited supply.

text.p: Sugar prices held steady in a narrow price band on the local market on Tuesday, dealers said.
"Consumer demand was low despite approaching festivals but limited supplies kept prices quiet," one dealer said.

In ready delivery sugar S-30 was quoted at 1,358/1,395 rupees per quintal while M-30 was available at 1,385/1,425 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery however slid from 1,300/1,320 rupees to 1,295/1,310 rupees per quintal on fresh offerings by mill owners following sluggish outstation demand.
"Traders expect higher supplies soon, on increased offerings by millers," a broker said.--Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
